# Prompts index

Active prompts in `.github/prompts/` (short descriptions):

- `new-feature.prompt.md` — implement a GitHub issue (branch, plan, metadata)
- `commit-message.prompt.md` — generate commit messages per CONTRIBUTION_GUIDE
- `pr-description.prompt.md` — create PR bodies from metadata or diffs
- `review-pr.prompt.md` — PR review checklist / automated reviewer helper
- `review-architecture.prompt.md` — architecture enforcement checks
- `OVERVIEW.prompt.md` — project overview & quick context for agents
- `how-to-implementation.prompt.md` — consolidated how-to for audio & animation
- `debug.prompt.md` — consolidated debug (audio | memory)
- `generate-tests.prompt.md` — create unit test suggestions and scaffolding

Archived prompts (moved to `.github/prompts/archived/`):
- `manage-milestone-issues.prompt.md` — milestone maintenance (archived)
- `how-schedule-audio.prompt.md` — replaced by `how-to-implementation` (archived)
- `how-animate.prompt.md` — replaced by `how-to-implementation` (archived)
- `debug-audio.prompt.md` — replaced by `debug.prompt.md` (archived)
- `debug-memory.prompt.md` — replaced by `debug.prompt.md` (archived)
